samples.question: A reference group of three black bars is shown in the top box. The bars sit on a shared baseline and each has a different height, so they form a left-to-right arrangement ordered by height. The image below is split into four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right); each quadrant contains its own group of three black bars on a shared baseline. Exactly one quadrant's three bars are arranged in the SAME left-to-right height order as the reference group (the same pattern of shortest, middle, and tallest reading left to right). The other three quadrants each have a different arrangement. Which quadrant contains the group whose three-bar height order matches the reference group? Answer with one quadrant name.
